correctness.rationale: All 20 vertices and 30 edges are reconstructed from explicit modulo-ten definitions; BFS gives pair distances 30/60/60/30/10. Exhaustive clique enumeration yields 260 and 3200 faces at thresholds two and three. Actual standalone certificates verify respectively 120 and 1599 free-face Morse pairs, critical cells {one 0, nineteen 2} and {one 0, one 3}, and global acyclicity of the complete directed face-poset graph. Forman yields integral wedge-of-19 S2 and S3. The threshold-four complement is an exact perfect matching, hence the join of ten S0 is S9; threshold five is a simplex. Between stages, nonzero reduced homology degrees are pairwise disjoint, fixing every integral persistence interval. Independent mod-two rank cross-checks agree, but are not used to infer integral homotopy.

value.rationale: The exact homotopy and integral barcode classification of the canonical 20-vertex Desargues graph is a motivated natural topological invariant: it has a nontrivial nineteen-S2 stage, then an S3 stage, then an S9 antipodal crosspolytope stage. This is not obtained from the existing graph-square high-girth theorem or the same-graph Čech calculation; the exact integrated filtration helps distinguish graph-metric topology across scales, including the disappearance of all lower-dimensional homology. No general-family theorem is claimed.
